$description: Design tokens extracted from Figma — Gemini Distribution landing page (fileKey xtrWSXTTvYY0PPol4tbynj, node 1320:49). No Figma variables were bound to text or color; every value below was read directly off individual layers. Typography (below) and color/gradient sections 1-2 (Header+Hero, Brand Strip) are exact, pulled via the Figma API. Color sections 3-14 were extracted by pixel-sampling a full-resolution PNG export after the Figma API hit its Starter-plan monthly quota (20 calls/month) — those are flagged "precision": "approx" and are close but not exact hex values.

display.usage: The one real system font — ~95% of all text on the page.

logo.usage: Header logo wordmark only. Treat as a brand asset, not a reusable token.

accentCard.usage: One-off: 'Wholesale Benefits' glass card in the Stock-Up banner. Flagged inconsistency.

strayNewsletter.usage: One-off stray span in footer newsletter placeholder. Flagged as likely a mistake — do not reuse.

displayTight.note: Consistent -2% of font size on every large heading (61px/49px/31px all divide out to the same ratio).

labelWide.note: Consistent +7% tracking, always paired with text-transform: uppercase, exclusive to eyebrow/label pills.

display.statement.usage: Footer 'STAY CONNECTED WITH WHAT'S NEW' banner headline. Largest text on the page, used exactly once.

heading.h1.usage: Main section headline — repeats on every content section (hero, best sellers, benefits, stock-up, warehouse, testimonials, blog, FAQs, contact).

heading.h1Compact.usage: Used once — brand/logo strip headline 'Everything your shelves need, in one catalogue'. Verify with design whether this should just be heading.h1 or heading.h3.

heading.h2.usage: 'Canada' map label in the Warehouse & Shipping section.

heading.h3.usage: Certification card titles: Licensed Business, Verified Distributor, Authentic Products, Secure Ordering, Serving All Canada.

heading.h4.usage: Benefit-card titles ('Exclusive Wholesale Pricing' etc.), product-card counter digits.

heading.h4Alt.usage: Benefit-card index numbers ('01 /', '02 /'...) — same size as heading.h4, lighter weight to sit behind the title visually.

heading.h5.usage: Contact page info-card titles: Address, Call Us, Email Us.

heading.h6.usage: Product card titles, FAQ question text, form field labels.

body.xl.usage: Testimonials — the featured (center, larger) quote only.

body.lg.usage: Testimonials — the two dimmed side-card quotes.

body.titleSm.usage: Blog card title, footer column headers (Categories/Brands/Quick Links/Wholesale), contact form field labels.

body.base.usage: Default paragraph copy directly under an H1 — hero paragraph, section subheadlines that use Regular weight.

body.baseMedium.usage: Same size as body.base but Medium weight — testimonial role/company line, warehouse subheadline, feature descriptions, tab labels.

label.eyebrow.usage: The small pill badge sitting above every section H1: Featured Brands, Benefits, Testimonials, Warehouse & Shipping, FAQs, Blog, Contact.

label.counter.usage: Hero image carousel counter '02'. Same recipe as label.eyebrow but SemiBold instead of Medium.

button.label.usage: Every CTA button on the page: Apply for Wholesale Account, Shop Wholesale, Browse full catalog, Send Message, Log in.

body.navSm.usage: Header primary nav links (Categories, Vape & e juices, Smoking, etc.) — the smallest nav text.

body.nav.usage: Top utility bar links ('Federal', 'Log in') and the free-shipping/18+ notice strip.

body.sm.usage: Blog category pills, form placeholder text, footer link lists, blog meta line ('June 2026 - 5 min read' is SemiBold).

body.legal.usage: Footer bottom bar: copyright notice, Terms & Conditions, Privacy Policy.

caption.xs.usage: Product card 'STARTING FROM' label, benefit-card descriptions, warehouse feature descriptions.

chip.quiet.usage: 'Login to View Price' micro-copy under gated pricing.

typographyFlagsForDesignReview: Header logo uses NCS Radhiumz (gradient); footer logo uses Inter Tight SemiBold (different gradient) — same wordmark rendered in two different typefaces.
'Wholesale Benefits' card (Stock-Up banner section) is entirely Denim-TRIAL — the only real UI copy on the page that isn't Inter Tight.
Footer 'Enter Your Email Address' placeholder mixes an Instrument Sans wrapper with Inter Tight character spans in the same line — looks like a stray paste from another file.

heading.h1 (49px) and heading.h1Compact (31px) are both 'H1-level' semantically but sized very differently, and h1Compact is used only once — confirm with design whether that's intentional or a legacy leftover.

brand.purpleDeep.usage: Primary brand purple — the single most-used color on the page. Gradient start stop, glow-shadow base, and (pixel-confirmed) the fill/gradient-start on every CTA button, icon badge, and active state across all 14 sections.

brand.purpleBright.usage: Gradient end stop, always paired with brand.purpleDeep (Figma shorthand was #c6f).

brand.purpleAccent.usage: Logo wordmark gradient's final stop only.

surface.purplePanel.usage: Flat (non-gradient) deep-purple background — used once, on the Promotions/'Margin-building programs' panel.

text.ink.usage: Primary text color everywhere on the page — never pure #000.

text.ink50.usage: Secondary/muted text (paragraphs, subheadlines) — ink at 50% opacity, not a separate gray.

text.ink20.usage: Faint dividers, inactive progress track, inactive carousel-arrow border.

text.ink8.usage: Very faint fill — inactive progress bar segments.

border.purple30.usage: Secondary-button border; also the base color of the pill-badge glow shadow.

surface.white.usage: Header bar, cards, input fields, most section backgrounds.

surface.lilacWash.usage: Hero background wash; approx-confirmed reused as the page background on Testimonials and Warehouse & Shipping sections.

surface.nearBlack.usage: Top utility strip background; approx-confirmed as the fill for EVERY dark eyebrow-pill badge across all 14 sections (Product Categories, Featured Brands, Benefits, Promotions, Warehouse & Shipping, Testimonials, FAQs, Blog, Contact).

surface.cardGray.usage: Neutral light-gray card background — product cards, benefit cards, contact form panel, info cards.

status.ratingGold.usage: Testimonial star ratings — the only non-purple, non-neutral accent color found anywhere on the page.

brandCta.usage: THE workhorse gradient. Primary hero CTA, active hero-carousel bar, every Explore/Shop/Browse/Send/Subscribe button across all 14 sections, blog arrow buttons, FAQ expanded-item background.

sectionGlowBand.usage: Brand/Logo-Strip section background — a soft purple glow peaking in the vertical middle.

stockUpBanner.usage: Stock Up Banner section background, with a blurred building photo composited underneath and product photos in the foreground.

footerMesh.usage: Footer section background — reads as a soft 'aurora' blur behind the newsletter block. Best implemented as layered radial-gradients or a background image, not a single linear-gradient.

certificationHighlight.usage: Background photo panel behind the 'Authentic Products' certification card — the one highlighted card of five.

shadowBadgeGlow.usage: Hero pill badge — soft purple glow, no spread, large blur.

shadowButtonHairline.usage: Primary hero CTA button — tight neutral edge-definition shadow.

shadowCardSoft.usage: Consistent 'resting elevation' shadow across testimonial, product, benefit, and contact cards.

glassmorphism.value: background: rgba(255,255,255,0.18); backdrop-filter: blur(20px); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3)
glassmorphism.usage: 'Wholesale Benefits' card floating over the Stock Up Banner — the one true frosted-glass element on the page.

watermarkGhost.usage: Oversized 'Gemini Distribution' watermark text behind the footer newsletter headline.

colorFlagsForDesignReview: One dominant accent color used with total discipline across all 14 sections (#6b3aac -> #cc66ff) — a strength worth codifying as a single locked token pair so it's never redefined slightly differently by accident.
Footer logo mark uses a solid icon + solid black text, while the header logo uses a gradient wordmark — a second inconsistency on top of the font mismatch already flagged in typography.

The 'Authentic Products' certification card is the only one of 5 with a photographic/gradient treatment instead of a flat white card — confirm this is an intentional featured callout, not a leftover state.

No obvious pattern governs which sections sit on white vs. the lilac-wash background (Testimonials and Warehouse & Shipping are lilac; Benefits, Blog, Contact, FAQs are white) — worth checking whether that's a deliberate alternating rhythm or inconsistent.

contentMaxWidth.usage: = 1440 - 2*100. Used in 9 of 14 sections (Header, Featured Products, Best Sellers, Benefits, Stock Up Banner, Warehouse, Testimonials, FAQs, Blog, Contact).

horizontalMargin.usage: Standard side margin producing the 1240px content column.

sectionVerticalPadding.usage: Standard section padding, used by the same 9 sections as contentMaxWidth.

headerBlockToContentGap.usage: Gap between a section's eyebrow+H1+subhead block (consistently 244px tall) and its first content row — seen in Best Sellers, Blog, Contact and others sharing this header pattern.

standardGridGap.usage: Best Sellers product grid, Blog card grid, Benefits card row, Contact form-vs-info-column gap. Divides the 1240px content width evenly for 3-column grids (392px card + 32px gap x2 = 1240).

space3xs.usage: Icon-in-box padding (20px icon centered in a 28x24 box).

space2xs.usage: Eyebrow-pill inner inset (Blog/Contact style pills); also the tight 3-sided card frame inset seen on Blog cards.

spaceXs.usage: Tab-pill container inset (Best Sellers tab group).

spaceSm.usage: Certifications grid gap (the one section using a tighter-than-standard gap); card image-to-text gap inside a Best Sellers product card; Blog card's bottom inset (looser than its other 3 sides).

spaceMd.usage: Benefits card internal padding (symmetric on all 4 sides of a 285x289 card); Contact page's 3 stacked info-card vertical gap.

spaceLg.usage: THE standard grid column gap across the page; also Contact form-panel internal padding and the gap between Contact's form column and info-card column.

spaceXl.usage: Standard section top/bottom padding; Best Sellers' row-to-row and row-to-button gaps; Promotions panel's (non-standard) side margins.

space2xl.usage: Header-block-to-content gap; Certifications section's (non-standard) top/bottom padding.

space3xl.usage: Standard page horizontal margin, producing the 1240px content column.

spacingScale.note: There isn't one shared base unit for the whole page. Component-level spacing (icon padding, pill insets, card padding) clusters on a 4px increment (4/6/8/20/24/32). Section-level macro spacing uses round decades (50/60/100) that are NOT multiples of 8 — treat as two independent scales, not one grid extended upward.

radiusNone.usage: Full-bleed section backgrounds (map illustration, banner photography) — radius lives on inner content panels, not the section shell.

radiusSm.usage: Contact form input fields, smaller UI chrome.

radiusMd.usage: Hero banner image (exact 20px); approx-matches product/blog/testimonial/benefit card images.

radiusLg.usage: Large banner panels: Promotions panel, Stock Up Banner.

radiusFull.value: 50-99px depending on element height (always fully rounded)
radiusFull.usage: Every button and pill badge on the page: hero CTA (50px), secondary Log-in button (69px), carousel progress track (99px), every eyebrow pill across all 14 sections.

sectionLayoutDetail.note: Full per-section breakdown (outer padding, grid gaps, card internal padding, one representative card's measurements) is in spacing-report.md alongside this file — kept out of this JSON to avoid duplicating a large narrative table in a machine-consumable format. Two sections deviate from the standard 100px/50px pattern: the Promotions panel uses 50px side margins (not 100px), and Certifications uses 60px top/bottom padding (not 50px) plus a tighter 20px grid gap with an intentional left-edge card bleed.

layoutFlagsForDesignReview: Promotions panel uses 50px side margins vs. the page's standard 100px — confirm intentional (different visual weight for a 'statement' panel) vs. drift.

Certifications section uses 60px top/bottom padding (vs. standard 50px) and a tighter 20px grid gap (vs. standard 32px), with its first card intentionally bleeding off the left edge — confirm the overflow/crop is deliberate.

Contact and Footer appear to share one layer subtree in the Figma file rather than being cleanly separated top-level frames, which makes Footer's spacing screenshot-approximated rather than metadata-exact, and makes future edits to either section riskier for whoever maintains the Figma file.
